cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Homa is an offline agricultural AI assistant by FallbackAI that provides crop disease diagnosis, fertilizer recommendations, pest management, seasonal planting guidance, and yield optimization for rural African farmers.

test_prompts.prompt: I am a farmer in Oyo State Nigeria. My maize crop has yellowing leaves after 4 weeks of planting. Give me a detailed diagnosis and step by step treatment plan including fertilizer names and quantities.
How do I control Fall Armyworm in my maize farm in Benue State? Give detailed integrated pest management steps.
